visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a blue and white vertical striped denim shirt over a white t-shirt, sits in a well-lit indoor room. He is positioned in front of a professional black microphone on a boom arm. Behind him, a cream-colored wall features a map-like poster. He speaks directly to the camera, using expressive hand gestures with both hands to emphasize his points. (2) A rectangular graphic overlay appears in the upper middle of the frame, showing a YouTube-style thumbnail with text and an image of Moai statues on Easter Island. The man continues talking in the background. (3) The man returns to full view, continuing his narrative. His facial expressions are relatively serious but engaged. He adjusts his glasses briefly with his right hand. (4) Another thumbnail overlay appears, this time showing various food dishes and text about food prices on Easter Island. The man is still visible and speaking behind the overlay. (5) The man is back in focus. As he recounts a story, his facial expressions become more exaggerated and humorous; he squinted his eyes, smiles broadly, and even sticks his tongue out slightly while laughing. His gestures become larger and more dynamic as the video concludes.

[Subtitle]: 很矛盾的一點就是我知道這件事情如果解決我拍影片的話. [Subtitle]: 回頭看會很好笑. (2) [Slogan]: 受困復活節島 (SOS) 預出求救訊號. (3) [Subtitle]: 我在那邊欠錢然後在那邊滴scovery的腳本然後在那邊學西文非常的緊繃. [Subtitle]: 你聽完這個幕後故事之後你去看那一支復活節島物價.
